title: Editor: tighten cursor_col contract — pin the exact column (ens result == cursor - line_start), not just bound it (<= cursor); kills the surviving return-0 mutant

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Closed #126. (A) Fixed the toolchain gap in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs: lower_spec_fn_body / lower_spec_fn_body_with_schemes / spec_dec now thread a spec fn's &String params via .with_strings(..) (new string_param_names/is_string_ty helpers), so a &String-param byte_at(i) in a spec-fn body rewrites to spec_byte_at(i as int) (was bare → E0308 usize-vs-int) and a dec s.len() to s.spec_len(). Two narrowings for Verus's unbounded-int spec arithmetic: a recursive spec-fn-call arg i+1 → (i+1) as u64, a contract s.len() arg → s.spec_len() as u64 (gated on plain_user_spec_call); the s→s.data@ byte-view is gated on callee_takes_string_byteview so a user &String-param spec fn's self-call passes the &TString reference through. (B) Added spec_line_start (spec twin of exec line_start) and pinned cursor_col: ens result == b.cursor - spec_line_start(&b.text,0,b.cursor,0). cursor_col now L3 4/4 (return-0 and return-cursor mutants → L0); editor builds + runs identically. Gauntlet: cargo test --workspace 192 passed 0 failed; clippy + fmt clean.
